item.title: One Year After $19 Billion Crash, Crypto Faces a New Reality
item.description: A year ago, crypto was riding a wave of White House support, Wall Street enthusiasm and expectations of a new golden age. Then came October’s historic crash, wiping out a record $19 billion in leveraged bets in a single day, setting off an industry-wide retrenchment and exposing the fragility of a market structure supposedly coming of age.
item.dc:creator: David Pan
